activities.subject: Route planning software
activities.body: Hi Sam, we're evaluating options to replace our routing spreadsheets. We have 12 dispatchers and planning eats most of their mornings. Could we set up a call next week?

activities.subject: Discovery call
activities.body: Priya and Daniel joined. Manual route planning costs the team about 15 hours a week across dispatchers. Anything above $40k needs CFO approval; Priya hasn't introduced us to the CFO yet. Daniel is worried about migrating data from their current tool.
They are also trialing RouteMax; the trial ends Nov 15. Priya said she prefers our interface.

activities.subject: Proposal and pricing
activities.body: Hi Priya, attached is the annual plan proposal we discussed: $48,000 for 12 dispatcher seats, including migration support. Happy to walk through it whenever suits you.

name: Brightline Dental Group — 14-Clinic Rollout
next_step: Security review call with Marcus on Oct 22
pain_points: No-shows and inconsistent scheduling across 14 clinics

activities.subject: Scheduling across our clinics
activities.body: Hi Sam, we want to standardize scheduling across our 14 clinics. No-shows are costing us real revenue and every clinic does reminders differently. Can you show us the platform?

activities.subject: Product demo
activities.body: Elena and Marcus attended. Elena liked automated reminders and the multi-clinic dashboard. Marcus needs our SOC 2 report and a completed security questionnaire before procurement can start.

activities.subject: SOC 2 report and security questionnaire
activities.body: Hi Marcus, attached are our SOC 2 Type II report and the completed questionnaire. Would a security review call on Oct 22 work for you?

activities.subject: Re: SOC 2 report and security questionnaire
activities.body: Thanks Sam. Oct 22 works. I'll bring someone from procurement. Budget for this is approved for Q4.
Elena will present her vendor choice at the board meeting on Nov 20.

activities.subject: Pricing negotiation
activities.body: Tom asked for a 10% discount on an annual commitment. He wants to start with a pilot at the Dayton plant, where scrap rate tracking is still done by hand.

activities.subject: Revised contract
activities.body: Hi Tom, attached is the revised contract with an 8% discount on the annual commitment and the Dayton pilot scope.

activities.subject: Automatic reply: Revised contract
activities.body: Tom Becker is no longer with Kestrel Manufacturing. For operations matters please contact Aisha Rahman.

activities.subject: Pilot status
activities.body: Hi Jordan, budget for new software is frozen until our new VP of Operations starts in November. We're still interested in the Dayton pilot, but I can't sign anything myself.
Need to find out who the new VP of Operations is and when exactly they start.
